definition: The slope gradient of an elevation model at each cell, from a local fit of the surface by the 9 parameter 2nd order polynom of Zevenbergen & Thorne (1987).

hasAction.description: The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/slope to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/slope, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/slope/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

source.title: Zevenbergen, L.W., Thorne, C.R. (1987): Quantitative analysis of land surface topography. Earth Surface Processes and Landforms, 12: 47-56
